properties.name: MEASURED 2026-10-06: tools/install.sh gave up when the GitHub CLI was installed but not signed in, though the release is public and plain curl works
properties.statement: tools/install.sh used `gh release download` whenever gh was on PATH, and treated gh's failure as the end of the install ("could not download ... (gh)"), with no fallback to curl. A gh that is installed but not signed in fails even on a public release, so such a machine could not install reflow2 by the documented one-line command, though curl alone would have worked. FOUND 2026-10-05 by reading the v0.80.0 installer while writing an upgrade recipe; MEASURED 2026-10-06 by a stand-in gh that refuses and a stand-in curl that serves the release: the installer from main at 69a23912 fails, and with the fix it installs through curl and says it fell back.
